$comment: ENG-1598 canonical DfM parity-corpus manifest (fixtures/dfm/**). Supersedes the ENG-1393 corpus at packages/dfm/corpus/** (AC7 — folded here, single source of record). Lists: (1) the 15 registered PM node types + 12 registered marks the TS @orvex/dfm registry proves against (registeredTypes()/registeredMarkTypes()), each authored as a language-neutral <case>.pm.json <-> <case>.dfm.md pair under nodes/ and marks/; (2) opaque reference exemplars under opaque/; (3) the 22 engine block-schema-catalog embed types (GET /api/schemas/blocks, live-enumerated 2026-07-08 from apps/server/src/orvex/page-blocks/handlers/*.ts + schemas-catalog.spec.ts) that are NOT first-class @orvex/dfm node types, each authored as a documented opaque-fence fixture under embeds/ (AC1/AC4); (4) both mention formats under mentions/ (AC5). 'table' and 'callout' are the two catalog types already covered as first-class node fixtures (nodes/table.*, nodes/callout.*) -- they are cross-referenced, not duplicated, in embeds/.
$notes: catalog_embed_types_first_class + catalog_embed_types_opaque = 2 + 22 = 24, the full live GET /api/schemas/blocks enumeration (AC3). internal: parse-only/documented-exclusion type names never returned by registeredTypes()/registeredMarkTypes() (kept for forward-compat). opaque_exemplars: synthetic never-registered type names (excalidraw/drawio) exercising the reference opaque-fence path with the ENG-1393-authored ids, distinct from the embeds/ catalog fixtures which use the live catalog's own type names.
